# Runpod Provider

Manage Runpod GPU and CPU pods, Serverless endpoints, templates, network volumes, Instant Clusters, account SSH keys and container registry credentials through the Runpod REST API v2.

**Using an AI agent?** Point it to https://docs.runpod.io/agent-setup.md to install the Runpod skills and MCP server.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_version = ">= 1.6"

  required_providers {
    runpod = {
      source  = "runpod/runpod"
      version = "~> 2.0"
    }
  }
}

provider "runpod" {}
```

## Authentication

Create an API key in the Runpod console (see
[Manage credentials](https://docs.runpod.io/get-started/credentials)). The provider reads it from the
`RUNPOD_API_KEY` environment variable, or from `api_key`; pass `api_key` from a sensitive variable, never a
literal. `base_url` / `RUNPOD_API_BASE_URL` change the API host and are needed only for a non-production
Runpod environment.

## Getting started

Each guide is a complete, runnable module: start with
[GPU pod](https://registry.terraform.io/providers/runpod/runpod/latest/docs/guides/gpu-pod),
[Serverless endpoint (GPU)](https://registry.terraform.io/providers/runpod/runpod/latest/docs/guides/serverless-endpoint),
or [Catalog discovery](https://registry.terraform.io/providers/runpod/runpod/latest/docs/guides/catalog-discovery)
to find GPU type ids and Serverless pools. Coming from 1.x? 2.0.0 is a breaking release; read
[Migrating from 1.x to 2.0.0](https://registry.terraform.io/providers/runpod/runpod/latest/docs/guides/migrating-from-1-x)
before you change the version pin.

## Schema

### Optional

- `api_key` (String, Sensitive) Runpod API key. Falls back to the RUNPOD_API_KEY environment variable.
- `base_url` (String) API base URL, for stage or self-hosted targets. Falls back to the RUNPOD_API_BASE_URL environment variable, then the production API.
- `graphql_url` (String) GraphQL endpoint for the deprecated GraphQL shims: the runpod_machine resource, the runpod_machine / runpod_machines data sources and the runpod_user data source. Falls back to the RUNPOD_GRAPHQL_URL environment variable, then https://api.runpod.io/graphql. Ignored by everything on the v2 REST API.
- `rest_v1_url` (String) REST v1 base URL for the deprecated REST v1 shims: the runpod_billing_pod / runpod_billing_network_volume / runpod_billing_endpoint data sources, and the deprecated attributes on runpod_pod, runpod_template (readme and docker_entrypoint among them), the runpod_template data source and runpod_serverless_endpoint. Falls back to the RUNPOD_REST_V1_URL environment variable, then RUNPOD_BASE_URL (the 1.x name for this host), then https://rest.runpod.io/v1. Ignored by everything on the v2 REST API.
